title: Cross-model falsification and posterior reliability for Earth-interior inference
purpose: Test whether an Earth-interior inference claim survives known-truth calibration, held-out predictive checks, alternative physical priors, unseen simulator families, and deliberate negative controls before it is described as robust.

central_paradigm.from: Select one plausible model, fit it, and display its best estimate.
central_paradigm.to: Treat every estimate as a falsifiable claim that competes against alternative explanations and can be downgraded when robustness evidence is insufficient.
central_paradigm.operating_rule: The strongest permitted conclusion is bounded by the weakest required evidence gate. Good in-family calibration, low ensemble disagreement, or a visually coherent field map alone never establishes that the real Earth follows the assumed model.

claim_boundary.current_status_sentence: Protocol only; no runs, calibration scores, falsification detections, or Earth-interior discoveries are claimed.

research_basis.title: Effects of geodynamo priors and geomagnetic data on inverted core surface flows
research_basis.implication: Prior and dynamo-setup sensitivity are first-class evaluation dimensions because inferred background flow can vary substantially with the chosen dynamo prior.

research_basis.title: Simulation-based inference with deep ensembles: evaluating calibration uncertainty and detecting model misspecification
research_basis.implication: Pairwise divergence across independently trained posterior estimators can flag instability or potential misspecification; agreement is necessary in some contexts but is not sufficient for correctness.

research_basis.title: Addressing Misspecification in Simulation-based Inference through Data-driven Calibration
research_basis.venue: ICML 2025, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 267
research_basis.implication: Simulation-based inference can be miscalibrated under simulator mismatch; calibration methods and real/held-out calibration evidence need separate evaluation.

research_basis.title: Simulation-Based Calibration Checking
research_basis.implication: Under the declared generative model, posterior rank statistics should be discrete-uniform; this diagnoses inference computation and calibration under that model, not whether the model describes Earth.

research_basis.title: Bayesian inversion for the filtered flow at the Earth's core-mantle boundary
research_basis.implication: Posterior reliability of inferred core flow is conditional on the selected prior constraints and scale, motivating explicit prior sensitivity and unresolved-scale reporting.

research_basis.title: Posterior SBC: simulation-based calibration checking conditional on data
research_basis.implication: Prior-predictive simulation-based calibration checks computational calibration averaged under a generative prior; conditional-on-data checks probe whether reliability changes in observation regimes resembling a particular observed dataset. The latter must still be evaluated on known-truth simulations and cannot establish real-Earth latent-state calibration.

research_basis.title: Flow Matching Calibration for Simulation-Based Inference under Model Misspecification
research_basis.venue: ICML 2026, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 306
research_basis.implication: Posterior correction using calibration examples is a candidate robustness method for simulator/noise/prior shift. In Earth-interior inference, hidden true core states are not directly labelled; therefore evaluate such corrections first on held-out known-truth simulation families and do not claim real-Earth latent posterior calibration without suitable ground-truth labels.

evaluation_lanes.question: Can the inference algorithm recover calibrated posteriors when data truly are generated by the declared model?
methods: simulation-based calibration rank statistics for each declared parameter
empirical coverage and sharpness of 50%, 90%, and 95% intervals
proper scoring rules on held-out simulated observations and latent states
recovery of known parameter scales, correlations, and posterior multimodality
evaluation_lanes.interpretation_limit: Passing L0 qualifies computational/statistical behavior under the generating model only.

evaluation_lanes.question: Can the fitted model reproduce preregistered features of held-out observations without using those observations in fitting?
diagnostics: temporal autocorrelation and spectral content of secular-variation residuals
spatial residual structure by coverage region and spherical-harmonic band where applicable
residual heteroscedasticity, correlated sensor errors, and missingness patterns
predeclared summaries of seismic differential travel-time observations when that modality is enabled
evaluation_lanes.rule: Freeze discrepancy statistics and reference distributions before evaluating the held-out data. Do not select diagnostics after observing which ones make a preferred model look good.

evaluation_lanes.question: Which estimated features survive credible alternative priors, truncation levels, temporal regularization and parameterizations?
required_variants: at least three scientifically documented prior/dynamo families where qualified
multiple stated spherical-harmonic truncations or equivalent model resolutions
explicit treatment or bounded sensitivity of unresolved scales
nuisance bias and model-discrepancy terms where applicable
evaluation_lanes.report: Feature-level stability, posterior displacement in scaled coordinates, uncertainty overlap, rank/identifiability changes, and parameter-specific sensitivity; never collapse all features into one opaque robustness score.

evaluation_lanes.question: Does the inference pipeline remain calibrated when evaluated data come from a simulator configuration or physics family not present in fitting?
shift_families: held-out geodynamo setup or boundary condition
held-out simulation resolution or spectral truncation
calibration bias or correlated systematic error
one declared discrepancy component omitted from the fitted family
evaluation_lanes.rule: Split by complete simulator configuration/family where possible, not only by randomly selected adjacent time steps. Hide held-out truth and labels from training, tuning, candidate observation selection, and threshold selection.

evaluation_lanes.question: Do independently trained inference estimators or physically defensible model families disagree enough to indicate unstable conclusions?
measures: pairwise posterior KL where estimable, with Monte Carlo error and estimator direction stated
symmetric alternative such as Jensen-Shannon divergence when a bounded symmetric diagnostic is preferred
posterior location/scale and multimodality disagreement for each quantity of interest
ensemble spread across seeds, training budgets, prior families, and simulator families
evaluation_lanes.interpretation_limit: Large disagreement is a warning requiring diagnosis; low disagreement cannot rule out shared systematic error or common misspecification.

evaluation_lanes.question: Can the system reject plausible-looking but incorrect evidence/model situations without peeking at the answer?
controls: shuffle observation times while preserving marginal values
inject a timestamp offset or unit-scale error
duplicate measurements with correlated errors but incorrectly mark the covariance as unknown
withhold a spatial band or introduce a known missing-not-at-random pattern
generate a competing physical hypothesis with near-identical nominal observable predictions
plant an exactly unobservable parameter direction
shift a boundary condition or noise family outside the fitted model family
corrupt source lineage or change an input artifact without updating its manifest identity
introduce a seismic event-pair phase/time mismatch when seismic evaluation is enabled
evaluation_lanes.required_response: Flag the affected claim, widen/downgrade uncertainty, report non-identifiability, or abstain according to the frozen protocol; do not silently produce a confident unique estimate.

evaluation_lanes.question: Does uncertainty calibration remain credible in the observation-conditioned regions actually encountered, or do prior-predictive aggregate checks mask local under-coverage?
methods: Run registered prior-predictive simulation-based calibration on known-truth synthetic ensembles.

Add posterior-SBC/conditional calibration diagnostics across predeclared observation strata: spatial coverage, signal-to-noise, temporal regime, missingness, correlated errors, and model-family shift.

Compare uncorrected posterior inference with deep-ensemble uncertainty diagnostics and, only when valid calibration truth exists, candidate posterior-correction methods such as data-driven calibration or flow-matching correction.
Report conditional interval coverage, proper predictive scores, sharpness, estimator disagreement and abstention per stratum, with sample size and confidence intervals.
controls: Construct two data strata where pooled coverage appears acceptable while one conditional stratum under-covers.
Generate an observation region outside the calibration set and test whether the system flags extrapolation rather than silently applying the correction.
Use calibration labels only from the declared training/calibration split; do not expose qualification labels or hidden state truth.
Test whether posterior correction improves coverage at the expense of uselessly broad intervals or degraded proper predictive scores.
evaluation_lanes.required_response: Flag localized miscalibration, abstain or downgrade the affected claim, and retain per-stratum failures even if aggregate coverage passes.
evaluation_lanes.interpretation_limit: This lane qualifies calibration on synthetic known-truth or genuinely labelled calibration cases only. Real geomagnetic measurements do not directly label the Earth's hidden core state; posterior calibration on simulated truth is not calibration proof for that real latent state.

registered_baselines: simple linear-Gaussian or low-order known-truth oracle on H0 cases
same inference method with simulation-based calibration and posterior predictive diagnostics disabled
the same method with model-family holdout enabled, for ablation comparison

protocol.development_split: Visible synthetic cases used to implement and debug the pipeline.
protocol.calibration_split: In-family known-truth cases used to calibrate uncertainty and freeze alert thresholds.
protocol.qualification_split: Blind known-truth cases with frozen configuration, not used for method/threshold tuning.
protocol.generalization_split: Entire simulator configurations/families and contiguous time intervals held out where possible.
protocol.real_observation_split: Separate later protocol only after source payloads and capture digests are independently verified; model training cutoff and data lineage must establish that test observations did not contribute to reference models used as baselines.
protocol.randomness: Record PRNG algorithm, seeds, independent repetitions, and stochastic inference sampling settings.
protocol.pre_registration: Freeze parameter scales, metrics, discrepancy statistics, alert thresholds, minimum effect sizes, exclusion rules, and aggregate formulas before evaluating blind cases.

values: simulation-based calibration rank statistic
50/90/95% interval coverage with binomial confidence intervals
proper log predictive score and CRPS where defined
interval sharpness paired with coverage
detection sensitivity by misspecification family
false-alert rate on in-family controls
calibration of alert thresholds
abstention precision and recall where a claim-status decision is defined
rank and null-space accuracy on exact fixtures
false-positive unique-solution rate
fraction of parameter/state dimensions explicitly reported as weakly identified or unidentifiable
feature-level sign/rank stability across prior families
posterior displacement in declared normalized coordinates
worst-case and lower-quantile held-out predictive score under simulator shift
uncertainty coverage degradation under each shift family
simulator evaluations
inference and diagnostic wall time
peak memory
human review units where applicable
coverage and sharpness stratified by predeclared observation regime
conditional-versus-pooled calibration gap with confidence intervals
proper predictive score and calibration shift after posterior correction
out-of-calibration-support detection and abstention rate
label/holdout leakage count

aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.target: 100% correct handling of deterministic analytic posterior and exact null-space controls.
aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.why: Any failure here blocks larger expensive benchmarks.

aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.target: For adequately powered in-family synthetic runs, 90% and 95% interval coverage within a predeclared tolerance (initial planning range: ±3 percentage points), with rank calibration assessed by a registered uniformity test.
aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.qualification: Report sample count, dependence assumptions, confidence intervals and per-parameter strata; do not use the tolerance as a universal scientific guarantee.

aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.target: On a preregistered misspecification suite, detect at least 80% of specified material shifts while limiting false alerts to at most 5% on matched in-family controls.
aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.qualification: Define shift magnitudes and statistical power before runs; also report each family separately and the missed-shift distribution.

aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.target: No confident unique-state claim on exact non-identifiable fixtures, and no benchmark success if uncertainty calibration deteriorates materially under declared shifts.
aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.qualification: Ablate each safeguard to measure which guardrail catches which failure.

aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.target: On adequately powered synthetic known-truth cases, report conditional nominal-90% interval coverage within a predeclared ±5 percentage-point range in every qualified stratum, while no material proper-score or sharpness regression is hidden by aggregate coverage.
aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.qualification: A planning target only. Freeze strata, sample counts, confidence intervals, and minimum practical score effects before blind evaluation. This does not assert that true core-state labels exist for real Earth observations.

fields: exact source or generator identities, versions and digests
forward model, inference method, priors, noise and observation operator versions
posterior sampling method and PRNG settings
predeclared thresholds, metrics and exclusion rules
per-case posterior/predictive diagnostics and per-family summaries
runtime, memory and simulator evaluation count
exact code commit, configuration digest, and qualification status

stop_rules: Passing simulation-based calibration does not waive model-misspecification testing.
Low estimator-ensemble divergence does not count as proof of accuracy.
A visually plausible map or low training residual does not qualify an Earth-state claim.
No random adjacent-sample split may be the only generalization evaluation.
No held-out truth, test observation, or post hoc diagnostic may influence model selection or threshold tuning.
No real-data qualification until exact source artifacts, provenance, licenses, capture digests and data-leakage audit are complete.
All failed negative controls, unstable features, exclusion decisions and negative results stay in the receipt.
Do not promote a posterior-correction method on pooled coverage alone if any preregistered observation stratum has material under-coverage.
Do not describe posterior-SBC success on synthetic known-truth cases as evidence of conditional calibration for the real Earth's hidden core state.
Do not use calibration methods requiring labelled latent truth on real Earth inference unless an independently justified truth-labelled calibration source is available.

cross_project_ownership.sol_atlas: Data/estimate contracts, versioned benchmark definitions and visualization of qualified versus underidentified quantities.
cross_project_ownership.symtropy: Deterministic known-truth generators, simulator-family shifts, observation operators, and physical applicability conditions.
